protein: VKOR / VKORC1 (vitamin K epoxide reductase, oxidoreductase)
readout: VAMP-seq abundance score, reporting steady-state protein level; higher is more stably folded
assay_method: VAMP-seq in human cells: VKOR is expressed as a fusion to a fluorescent protein so that steady-state abundance reports folding stability. Cells were sorted into bins by fluorescence and each bin deeply sequenced. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: The sequence is UniProt Q9BQB6 exactly, 163 aa, and every label verifies against it. 88 nonsense rows are dropped, a premature stop not being writable as a substitution. 128 synonymous row(s) are the wild-type protein and collapse to the single WT row at their mean. This paper yields two datasets because it measures two different properties of the same variants: carboxylation activity and, by VAMP-seq, steady-state abundance. They are separate work items, not two readouts of one.
